title: PAP Supply Replenishment Program: Coverage-Billed Disposable Filter Shipments
content:
**Rule.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, a coverage-billed line of disposable filters (A7038) ships against the patient's refill confirmation once that confirmation reaches the last day it may ship — the last of the schedule's refill lead days after the confirmation's contact date — and its units are worked out from the enrollment's records. The line is billed to the coverage record the enrollment bills.

## What the shipment books

- one coverage-billed disposable-filter line, shipping on the handling day;
- the units of disposable filters shipped on the line;
- the last day of use those units cover (the line's covered-through date);
- the coverage record billed.

The claim on the line is pending when it is booked, so its allowed, paid and patient amounts are recorded as 0.00.

## Booking the line — `ship_covered_refill_e8c1261e`

**Capability.** `ship_covered_refill_e8c1261e` books one coverage-billed shipment line of a PAP supply item on the patient's supply enrollment, shipping today. One call creates one shipped item line dated today, billed to the named coverage record, carrying the units shipped and the last day of use they cover. The line then appears in the enrollment's shipment history.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `ship_covered_refill_e8c1261e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `resupply_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's PAP supply enrollment, read from the enrollment lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `resupply_contact_id` | the reference number of the refill confirmation the shipment rests on, read from the refill-contact lookup before the call; it identifies this booking and is not stored on the line | identifier text |
| `coverage_id` | the reference number of the coverage record the line is billed to, read from the enrollment or coverage lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `hcpcs_code` | the supply item shipped | one of A7030 (full face mask), A7031 (full face mask cushion), A7034 (nasal mask or nasal pillows interface), A7032 (nasal mask cushion), A7033 (pair of nasal pillows), A7035 (headgear), A7036 (chinstrap), A7037 (standard tubing), A4604 (heated tubing), A7038 (disposable filter), A7039 (non-disposable filter), A7046 (humidifier water chamber); `none` never applies to an item line and is not accepted |
| `quantity` | the units of the item shipped on the line | a non-negative integer |
| `covers_through_date` | the last day of use the units shipped cover | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `shipping_method` | how the shipment travels | `ground` (the standard carrier), `expedited` (the faster paid service the patient asked for), `branch_pickup` (the patient collects it at a Summit Ridge branch); `none` never applies to a shipped item and is not accepted |

**Return.** A receipt in which `status` is `shipped` when the line was written; `resupply_line_id` is the reference number of the new line; `hcpcs_code` and `quantity` echo the item and units; `service_from_date` is today's ship date (YYYY-MM-DD); `covers_through_date` echoes the last day covered (YYYY-MM-DD); `billing_basis` is `coverage`; `coverage_id` echoes the coverage record billed.
